title: Watch Your Step: Adam's Margin Maximization Bias Depends on the Learning Rate Schedule
abstract: arXiv:2611.01929v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study the implicit bias of Adam and its similarity to sign gradient descent on homogeneous models in binary classification tasks. Perhaps surprisingly, we uncover that these depend on the learning rate schedule. While previous works studied strongly decaying learning rate schedules $\eta(t)=\mathrm o \left(t^{1/L-1}\right)$, where $L$ is the homogeneity degree, and showed $\ell_\infty$-margin-maximization biases, we focus on the more common complementary regime, including constant and weakly decaying schedules. For a polynomial schedule $t^{\alpha}$ and homogeneity degree $L$, we show that when $\alpha > \frac 1L - \frac12$, Adam has no trajectory-independent margin-maximization bias for deep linear networks (in the KKT sense): first, there is no non-trivial, locally Lipschitz, convex implicit regularizer in this setting, including any squared norm. Second, on width-$1$ networks, the result holds without requiring convexity, imply

translated_title: 小心你的步伐：Adam的间隔最大化偏差取决于学习率调度
translated_abstract: 我们研究了Adam的隐式偏差，以及其在二分类任务中于齐次模型上与符号梯度下降的相似性。或许令人惊讶的是，我们发现这些性质依赖于学习率调度。以往的工作研究了强衰减的学习率调度 $\eta(t)=\mathrm o\left(t^{1/L-1}\right)$（其中 $L$ 为齐次度），并证明了 $\ell_\infty$ 间隔最大化偏差；而我们聚焦于更常见的互补情形，包括恒定调度和弱衰减调度。对于多项式调度 $t^{\alpha}$ 和齐次度 $L$，我们证明当 $\alpha > \frac{1}{L} - \frac{1}{2}$ 时，Adam对深度线性网络不具有与轨迹无关的间隔最大化偏差（在KKT意义下）：首先，在此设置下不存在任何非平凡的、局部Lipschitz的凸隐式正则化器，包括任意平方范数；其次，在宽度为 $1$ 的网络中，该结论无需凸性假设即可成立……
tldr: 本文揭示了Adam的隐式偏差依赖于学习率调度——在常见的恒定或弱衰减调度下，Adam对齐次模型不再具有与轨迹无关的间隔最大化偏差。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that Adam's implicit bias depends on the learning rate schedule—under common constant or weakly decaying schedules, Adam loses its trajectory-independent margin-maximization bias on homogeneous models.
